## About
Bimmers R Us started when Greg Stroud bought his first car, a green BMW, and found that fixing it himself was cost efficient. Before long his family and friends were bringing their cars to his family's garage. After business classes and technical training, he moved into a building and, with his family's help, officially started the company.
Today we're an independent automotive repair shop that specializes in exclusive BMW service, with educated and informed technicians and prices lower than the dealers. We're also Missouri's largest authorized Dinan dealer, and we sell cars from our sales location on Lasalle St.
Greg puts it simply: we treat our customers as part of the Bimmers family. That family includes Jack, our general manager, service advisors Dave and David, partner Keith, and technicians Mike, Mani, Chris, Damion and Juan.

## Services
- Oil changes: Routine oil service for your BMW, done by people who know these engines.
- Warning lights: We track down what's behind the light on your dash, including the Oil Service and Inspection indicators.
- Enhanced Maintenance Service: Goes beyond BMW's factory warranty requirements, with additional services depending on the model year of your BMW.
- Standard Maintenance Service: Follows BMW's factory guidelines step by step and meets all BMW factory warranty requirements.
- Wheel and tire sales: Wheels and tires for your BMW, plus tire mount and balance.
- 2-wheel and 4-wheel alignment: Alignment to keep your BMW handling the way it should.
- Authorized Dinan dealer: Dinan parts and installs from Missouri's largest authorized Dinan dealer.
- Sales: Cars for sale at our separate sales location on Lasalle St.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on Minis too?
A: Yes. We work on BMWs and Minis, and the service request form lets you pick either BMW or Mini Cooper.

Q: When is the service shop open?
A: The service shop is open Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday. Sales keeps its own hours, so give them a call before visiting the Lasalle St. location.

Q: Is sales at the same address as service?
A: No. Service is on South Kingshighway Boulevard, and sales is at 2744 Lasalle St., St. Louis, MO 63104.

Q: Can you help with towing, upholstery or bodywork?
A: We don't do those in-house, but we have connections for towing services, auto upholstery, and paint and bodywork for our customers.

Q: Can I pick a date for my service?
A: Yes, the service request form asks for your desired date. We'll do our best to meet it, depending on our availability.
